anomalies.description: A birthday cake appeared in a Halloway West break room with no catering order, no delivery, no fabrication, no identified material source. One slice was missing.
anomalies.notes: Deliberately ambiguous (meta_anomaly_design.md worked example). The local Dev found no material provenance and correctly closed the case as MATERIAL PROVENANCE: UNRESOLVED — this does not by itself mean Bloomrot. Noor's cross-department query later finds twenty-three records with similar properties, nine involving a missing portion of something otherwise complete; that pattern is the first evidence of possible displacement rather than purely local provenance.

anomalies.description: Western Tolerance Hall began evacuating for no reason, eleven weeks after the South Quay correction, with no local resignation crisis, no walkout, no procedural refusal present.
anomalies.notes: Same physical behavior as South Quay (mass movement toward exits), different causal architecture. The Choir diagnosed this as a local anomaly and corrected it, which is precisely the mechanism meta_bloomrot.md identifies as feeding the network further.
